# SOGACOT - Sociedad Gallega de Cirugía Ortopédica y Traumatología

> > Scientific society dedicated to advancing orthopedic surgery and traumatology through research, clinical guidelines, and evidence-based practice in Galicia, Spain.

SOGACOT curates and publishes orthopedic research articles covering spine surgery, joint arthroplasty, trauma management, and innovative treatments. The organization features work from leading researchers including Dr. Vaquero and Dr. Caeiro, with publications in major journals like the European Spine Journal and Journal of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons.

## Key Topics

- Orthopedic surgery
- Spine surgery and spinal stenosis
- Total knee arthroplasty (TKA)
- Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty (UKA)
- Osteonecrosis of the femoral head (ONFH)
- Knee osteoarthritis
- Pelvic and hip fractures
- Elbow and ankle arthroplasty
- Meniscal repair and preservation
- Surgical outcomes and complications
- Evidence-based clinical guidelines
- Lansoprazole therapy for osteonecrosis prevention
- MRI diagnostics
- Biomarkers (C-reactive protein)
- Cervical discectomy and spinal fusion

## Knee Surgery and Arthroplasty

- [Position statement: the epidemiology, pathogenesis and risk factors of osteoarthritis of the knee](https://sogacot.org/articulos/position-statement-the-epidemiology-pathogenesis-and-risk-factors-of-osteoarthritis-of-the-knee): Position statement on knee osteoarthritis epidemiology and risk factors
- [Time for a paradigm change in meniscal repair: save the meniscus!](https://sogacot.org/articulos/time-for-a-paradigm-change-in-meniscal-repair-save-the-meniscus): Paradigm shift advocating meniscus preservation in knee surgery
- [Greater activity, better range of motion and higher quality of life following unicompartmental knee arthroplasty](https://sogacot.org/articulos/greater-activity-better-range-of-motion-and-higher-quality-of-life-following-unicompartmental-knee-arthroplasty-a-comparative-case-control-study): UKA vs TKA case-control study comparing activity and quality of life
- [Analysis of the Causes of Elevated C-Reactive Protein Level After Primary Total Knee Arthroplasty](https://sogacot.org/articulos/analysis-of-the-causes-of-elevated-c-reactive-protein-level-in-the-early-postoperative-period-after-primary-total-knee-arthroplasty): C-reactive protein elevation causes after total knee arthroplasty

## Spine Surgery and Clinical Guidelines

- [Evidence-Based Recommendations for Spine Surgery](https://sogacot.org/articulos/evidence-based-recommendations-for-spine-surgery): Evidence-based spine surgery recommendations for spondylolisthesis
- [Danish national clinical guidelines for surgical and nonsurgical treatment of patients with lumbar spinal stenosis](https://sogacot.org/articulos/danish-national-clinical-guidelines-for-surgical-and-nonsurgical-treatment-of-patients-with-lumbar-spinal-stenosis): Danish Health Authority guidelines for lumbar spinal stenosis treatment
- [Evaluation of bony fusion after anterior cervical discectomy: a systematic literature review](https://sogacot.org/articulos/evaluation-of-bony-fusion-after-anterior-cervical-discectomy-a-systematic-literature-review): Systematic review of bony fusion evaluation after cervical discectomy
- [Timing of PMMA cement application for pedicle screw augmentation affects screw anchorage](https://sogacot.org/articulos/4696-2): PMMA cement timing effects on pedicle screw anchorage in spine surgery
- [Spinal surgery complications: Is the WHO Safety Surgical Checklist an useful tool to reduce them?](https://sogacot.org/articulos/spinal-surgery-complications-an-unsolved-problem-is-the-world-health-organization-safety-surgical-checklist-an-useful-tool-to-reduce-them): WHO Safety Surgical Checklist effectiveness in spinal surgery
- [Non-specific chronic low back pain: differences in spinal kinematics in subgroups during functional tasks](https://sogacot.org/articulos/non-specific-chronic-low-back-pain-differences-in-spinal-kinematics-in-subgroups-during-functional-tasks): Spinal kinematics differences in chronic low back pain subgroups

- [Pelvic Fractures: Part 2. Contemporary Indications and Techniques for Definitive Surgical Management](https://sogacot.org/articulos/pelvic-fractures-part-2-contemporary-indications-and-techniques-for-definitive-surgical-management): Contemporary surgical techniques for definitive pelvic fracture fixation
